issues.title: SOP-104 locks out only FIL-2 and CAP-2 but the changeover also works on LAB-2, CPK-2 and CNV-2
issues.detail: SP-402 applies to all servicing, cleaning and jam clearing that puts any part of the body inside a guard on any equipment. SOP-104 locks out only FIL-2 and CAP-2 in preparation, then has operators change parts on the labeler, case packer and conveyor with no lockout stated. If those changes reach inside a guard, SP-402 requires a lock.

evidence.quote: Lock out FIL-2 and CAP-2 as described in SP-402.
change the case magazine guides and select the pack pattern
All servicing, cleaning and jam clearing that puts any part of the body inside a guard, on any equipment at Plant 2.

issues.title: SOP-102 shutdown cleaning does not refer to lockout
issues.detail: SOP-102 has operators clean the filler nozzles and drip tray and empty the case packer reject bin, and does not mention SP-402. SP-402 covers cleaning that puts any part of the body inside a guard. Whether these tasks reach inside guards is not stated.

evidence.quote: Clean filler nozzles and the drip tray. Wipe the labeler rollers. Empty the case packer reject bin.
All servicing, cleaning and jam clearing that puts any part of the body inside a guard, on any equipment at Plant 2.

issues.title: QP-306 asks for a packed case at first-off but SOP-101 start-up does not produce one
issues.detail: QP-306 step 1 has the Operator bring the first 5 good bottles and one packed case to the QA bench, and QA checks the case in step 6. SOP-101 steps 11 and 12 run 20 bottles and take the first-off samples to the QA Technician, with no step for a packed case.

evidence.quote: Bring the first 5 good bottles and one packed case to the QA bench.
Run 20 bottles and stop. Take the first-off samples to the QA Technician.

issues.title: QP-306 checks cap removal torque against a range that WI-211 does not give
issues.detail: QP-306 step 3 passes the first-off cap if removal torque is inside the range in WI-211. WI-211 only gives an application torque with a tolerance for each cap size, and has the operator measure removal torque without stating a removal range.

evidence.quote: Cap: correct cap, removal torque inside the range in WI-211.
Set the application torque from the table below.

consistent.title: Two values for minimum vacuum (case packer)
consistent.why: Measured at different points: MP-502 reads at least 0.7 bar at the pump inlet with the erector idle, WI-213 reads at least 0.6 bar at the erector cups with a case on them. The lower figure at the cups is expected, but neither document says how the two relate.

consistent.title: Compare: who releases the line
consistent.why: MP-501 (Shift Lead releases after maintenance), SOP-104 (Shift Lead releases for changeover) and SOP-101 (Line Lead owns the start-up) describe different events and do not contradict each other. The Shift Lead versus Line Lead naming is left for the plant to decide.

consistent.title: Compare: who places product on hold
consistent.why: QP-315 lets anyone place product on hold, so the QA Technician (QP-303, QP-316), Line Lead (QP-303), Operator (WI-211, WI-212) are all allowed. QP-303's own roles table and step 5 name different people, but neither forbids the other.

consistent.title: Compare: who gives first-off approval
consistent.why: QP-306, SOP-101 and SOP-105 all give first-off approval to the QA Technician.

consistent.title: Compare: who releases packaging materials
consistent.why: QP-308 and WH-601 both give release to the QA Technician, and WI-212 only loads rolls that carry the QA release sticker.

consistent.title: Compare: which suppliers' packaging may be used
consistent.why: QP-309 limits purchasing to the listed supplier, QP-308 rejects lots from unlisted suppliers and WI-212 refuses rolls from unlisted suppliers. The three documents agree.

consistent.title: Compare: who checks the dock before entering a trailer
consistent.why: SP-405 and WH-601 both require the Forklift Driver to chock the wheels and lock the dock leveler before entering a trailer.
